narr: Deep moisture and a stalled frontal boundary left the area very susceptible to flash flooding from isolated, slow moving storms.
ev: Flooding has been noted along Fort Fisher Boulevard in Kure Beach. Law enforcement has blocked off several streets due to flooding.
Flash flooding was reported in multiple spots throughout Parkton including Victoria Drive, Blue Road, and West Parkton Tobermory Road.
Flash flooding was reported on roads near the intersection of East Church Street and North Ranking Street.
Roads flooded near the intersection of Lake Park and South Ocean Boulevards.
Flash flooding was reported near the intersection of Country Club Road and Eddie Sampson Road.
Water was reported flowing across Beatty's Bridge Road, necessitating barricades.
Flash flooding has resulted in high water along Old Whiteville Road between Willoughby and the Robeson County line. One water rescue was performed.
